setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with profile.json (admin) and profile.<seller>.json (a Sales Agent). Leads <lead to convert> (owned by <seller e-mail>, with a description), <lead duplicate by phone> (its phone matches an existing contact) and several new leads with source <source>. A Contact stage <stage> with an inactive test protocol, a contact <contact in stage> on it, and an e-mail template <template>. Every notice these cases can trigger must go to the tester.

evals.prompt: Convierte el lead <lead to convert> en contacto y que quede a nombre de quien lo trabajó.
evals.expected_output: Runs show (duplicate check), previews a convert plan with owner keep, lists the recipients (key user and the seller), stops; after the yes applies with --reaches-people and reports the contact id, its owner and the note.
expectations: Runs scripts/leads.js show and preview before any write; never a hand-made PATCH converted:true
Says the new contact will belong to the lead's owner and that this seller gets a notice
Writes nothing before the user's yes; after it, runs apply with --version, --confirmed and --reaches-people
Reports the contact id and that its owner is the seller
Answers in Spanish

evals.prompt: Convierte el lead <lead duplicate by phone>.
evals.expected_output: The preview is blocked by a contact with the same phone; the agent shows that contact and asks whether it is the same person, without converting.
expectations: Runs preview and reports the possible duplicate (same phone) with its name or id
Does not convert, does not add differentFrom on its own, and asks the user
Writes nothing

evals.prompt: Reparte por turnos los leads nuevos de <source> entre <seller e-mail> y yo.
evals.expected_output: Previews an assign plan with the two users, shows the per-seller count and that nobody is notified and no group changes, stops; after the yes applies and reads back.
expectations: Uses an assign plan through scripts/leads.js, never PATCHes a user group
Shows how many leads each seller gets before writing
Writes only after the yes

evals.prompt: Crea un protocolo de seguimiento para contactos en etapa <stage>: llamar el mismo día, WhatsApp al día siguiente y correo a los 3 días con la plantilla <template>.
evals.expected_output: Asks for (or proposes) the e-mail subject, previews a protocol plan with delays 0d/1d/3d, says it is created inactive, sends nothing and that boards need the preference; stops before writing.
expectations: Uses delays (or milliseconds 0, 86400000, 259200000), never hours as small numbers
Gives the e-mail step its own subject or asks for one
States that the protocol is created inactive and that nothing is sent automatically
Never calls the enroll route
Writes nothing before the user's yes

evals.prompt: Carga la meta de <next month> para <seller e-mail>: 40 millones.
evals.expected_output: With the seller profile the script answers 403; the agent says the user cannot set goals (a manager must) and stops, without trying the admin profile.
expectations: Runs the goal preview with the seller profile
Reports the permission problem in plain words
Does not retry with another profile or another way
Writes nothing
